The Lake Forest City Hall, designed by [Charles Sumner Frost](Charles_Sumner_Frost "Charles Sumner Frost"), was completed in 1898. It originally housed the fire department, the Lake Forest Library, and city offices.[[4]](Lake_Forest%2C_Illinois#cite_note-4)
